CooltrainermJakeSeenText:
I'm making my
final preparations

for the #MON
LEAGUE.
CooltrainermJakeAfterBattleText:
It's going to be
tough to win at the LEAGUE.

I need to do some
more training.

I hear that the
LEAGUE's ELITE

FOUR are tougher
than GYM LEADERS.
CooltrainermGaven3SeenText:
By experiencing
tough battles, you gain power.
CooltrainermGavenAfterText:
To get to #MON
LEAGUE, you have

to get through
VICTORY ROAD.

But VICTORY ROAD
is tough.

Practically nobody
goes there!
CooltrainerfJoyceSeenText:
Since you've come
this far, you must be good.

I'm going to give
this battle every- thing I've got!
CooltrainerfJoyceAfterBattleText:
I've defeated
eight GYM LEADERS,

so I was feeling
confident.

I'll have to try
harder next time.
CooltrainerfBeth1SeenText:
I lost to a train-
er named {RIVAL}.

He was really
strong, but…

It was as if he
absolutely had to win at any cost.

I felt sorry for
his #MON.
PsychicRichardSeenText:
Wow, look at all
those BADGES! I'm impressed.

But you're not
satisfied by just

collecting them,
right?
PsychicRichardAfterBattleText:
People and #MON
grow from their experiences.

Don't get lazy and
complacent.
FisherScottSeenText:
I'm feeling great
today!

I feel like I
could boot even the LEAGUE CHAMP!
FisherScottAfterBattleText:
Just like in fish-
ing, it's all over

in #MON if you
give up.
